settings: Your AI has full access. You can limit it here or by asking it.
instructions: New AI connections get full access to all current and future tools, including private records and media, with no end date. Call describe_connection (or get_api_context for API keys) to inspect the actual state, reason, end date and revision. Use reduce_connection with opId and expectedVersion to remove powers, shorten an end date, pause or revoke only your own connection. You can never widen or restore access. Only the person can restore it at https://movingmanifest.com/settings/ai. Reconnecting never removes a limit. Archive and restore are allowed; permanent deletion, purge, invitations, new share links, publishing and spending money are website-only.
question: What can my AI do here, and how do I limit it?
answer: When you connect your AI, it gets full access to your Moving workspace from the start: it can read, save, organise, archive and restore, including tools we add later, with no end date. You can limit it any time: in Settings → AI, or just ask your AI to limit itself (for example, ‘only read, don’t change anything’ or ‘pause access’). Your AI can narrow its own access but never widen it. Only you can give access back. It never permanently deletes anything, spends money or publishes for you. Invitations and new share links stay on the website.
